text:
Anya (Support): Customer reported Go SDK streaming responses get truncated and they see "invalid character '\x00' looking for beginning of value" in their decoder. Happens after a few hundred tokens.

Devon: Can you paste the logs and SDK version? Also is this hosted or dedicated?

Anya (Support): Hosted API, customer using go-redwood v0.9.1. Logs:
```
2026/03/15 14:02:13 stream: read 32768 bytes
2026/03/15 14:02:13 json: invalid character '\x00' looking for beginning of value
2026/03/15 14:02:13 stream: connection closed by peer
```
They say it works with the Node SDK and Python SDK.

Ravi: Tagging Sam (runtime). Could be chunked transfer + scanner buffer issue in Go client. Default bufio.Scanner max token = 64K.

Sam - Eng Runtime: Agree. If the server emits large chunks or the framing is not newline-delimited, Scanner will fail. What's our streaming framing currently? It should be newline-delimited JSON objects separated by "\n\n" for SSE-ish, but some models produce embedded nulls when content is truncated by the server.

Devon: Repro steps from customer:
1) go.mod: github.com/redwood/cli v0.9.1
2) Run this sample:
```go
resp, _ := client.Stream(ctx, &redwood.StreamRequest{Model: "rwkv-rapid"})
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
    var msg map[string]interface{}
    json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &msg)
    fmt.Println(msg)
}
```
3) after ~3-10s get json decode error.

Morgan: Minimal repro on our side? I can try.

Anya (Support): Customer also reports retry logic kicks in: partial payload then retry leading to duplicated partial frames.

Sam - Eng Runtime: Two likely issues: (A) client buffer too small to hold a single chunk if server flushes large tokens, (B) server and client framing mismatch — server uses chunked transfer with arbitrary boundaries, not guaranteed newline per chunk.

Ravi: Proposed quick mitigation for customer: switch to json.Decoder streaming instead of Scanner. Example:
```go
r := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
d := json.NewDecoder(r)
for {
    var obj map[string]interface{}
    if err := d.Decode(&obj); err != nil { break }
    fmt.Println(obj)
}
```
This tolerates arbitrary chunk boundaries.

Devon: Also add resilience to retry logic: only retry on idempotent errors and make sure to drain body before retry. Partial JSON should not trigger a retry that reconsumes the same stream.

Sam - Eng Runtime: On server side we should ensure we emit JSON objects separated by `\n` and avoid interior null bytes. I'll add a canonical JSON-lines framing layer at the gateway to protect older clients.

Morgan: I reproduced locally with v0.9.1 — increasing bufio.Scanner buffer avoids the crash but hides the real problem. Stack:
```
scanner: token too long
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

Anya (Support): Customer is blocked in production, requesting hotfix or workaround asap.

Ravi: Action items:
- Sam: add server-side JSON-lines gateway shim and deploy canary to prod (eng-runtime) — target: next 12h
- Devon: Draft Go SDK patch to replace Scanner with json.Decoder and handle partial reads + update retry semantics — target: patch and cut v0.10.3
- Morgan: Provide customer workaround: use json.Decoder snippet or set env REDWOOD_GO_SDK_SCANNER_BUFFER=262144
- Anya (Support): Keep customer updated, ask for request id and example response bodies.

Sam - Eng Runtime: I'll instrument the gateway to log largest chunk size and any null bytes. Posting back with findings.

CI Bot: Deployment job #7890 queued for runtime/gateway canary.

Devon: I'll open PR draft: github.com/redwood/go-sdk/pull/412 with tests that emulate split chunks and embedded nulls.

Anya (Support): Customer provided request id r-0a1b2c3d and sample hex of offending bytes. Attached in DM.

Sam - Eng Runtime: Found that our streaming buffer sometimes writes a zero byte at flush boundary when converting []byte slices — root cause in gateway flush code. Will push patch that avoids extra writes.

Ravi: Great. Once Sam's fix is canaried we can tell customer to revert to SDK v0.9.1 and retest; otherwise adv to upgrade to v0.10.3 once released.

Anya (Support): Thanks all — I'll update ticket and ping when customer confirms. :pray:
